description: Control USB devices and removable storage behavior.

policies.name: Disable AutoRun
policies.description: Disables AutoRun for all drive types.

policies.name: Display a Custom Message When Installation Is Prevented
policies.description: Displays a custom message when Windows prevents a device installation because of a policy setting.
policies.enabledValue: Device installation has been prevented by your system administrator.

policies.name: Display a Custom Message Title When Installation Is Prevented
policies.description: Displays a custom title when Windows prevents a device installation because of a policy setting.

policies.name: Prevent Installation of Removable Devices
policies.description: Prevents Windows from installing removable devices and updating their drivers.

policies.name: Prevent Installation of Unspecified Devices
policies.description: Prevents installation of devices that are not explicitly allowed by another device installation policy.
